why: Export: Maulerfiend fists + “2 magma cutters” (2× Magma cutter); gear keeps the export’s two. Weapons: one Magma cutter row (6" A2 3+ S9 -4 D6 [MELTA 2]) and Maulerfiend fists. GW prints one profile, “Magma cutters” A2, for the pair (Wahapedia ds/emperors-children_Maulerfiend: “This model’s lasher tendrils can be replaced with 2 magma cutters”; the same pattern on GW’s EC Faction Pack Defiler, lines 284/321). Where GW means two weapons it names the profile in the singular (Chaos Predator Destructor “2 heavy bolters”, “Heavy bolter”). So n 1 (2 attacks in total) is GW’s number, with New Recruit’s name kept and the deviation declared (deviations-bsdata.json field ranged.n; the code writes kind + '.n', so melee.n for a melee pair).
